title: Confident
slide_intent: Teach writers to support an assured tone with specific evidence. Readers need to understand what the organization knows and why that knowledge matters to people.
strategic_value: Relevant facts, results and stories can establish Frontline AIDS’ experience while respecting the expertise of others.
demonstration: The second principle pairs definitions of confidence with cautions about condescension and dismissiveness. The right-hand notes ask for relevant facts and a concise ending.
practical_value: Select a specific result or experience that supports the point. Remove padding after the claim and its evidence are clear.

content_islands.name: Principle identifier
content_islands.spec: Mark Confident in the chapter rail. Pair the large pale numeral 2 with its pink nameplate and the cyan underline.

content_islands.name: Definition and limits
content_islands.spec: Set the definition and explanation above the contrasts between pride and condescension, authority and coercion, and assertion and dismissal.

content_islands.name: Writing guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the cyan list for experience, relevant evidence and the instruction to stop once the message is complete.
